output.reason: The cited line [ev-da51dc686ad2] only names the metric. But the section that contains it [ev-1f419676f177] says the listed `cortex_`-prefixed metrics will now start with `loki_`. Operators keep the old prefix only by changing `metrics_namespace` from its default `loki` to `cortex`, and that setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release. That covers what changed (the metric `cortex_dns_failures_total`), how (renamed to `loki_dns_failures_total`), who is exposed (environments that leave `metrics_namespace` at the default `loki`) and what happens if they do nothing (the metric appears under the new name, so anything querying the old name stops matching).
